Title: Interactions Between the United States of America and the Soviet Union
Content: In `text(June 1948)`, the Soviet Union blockades democratic West Berlin. The U.S. and its allies fly in supplies `text(daily)` to keep the city from starving. The Soviets lift the blockade in `text(May 1949)`.
U.S. spy planes discover Soviet-built nuclear sites in Cuba. After a tense `text(13-day)` standoff with President John F. Kennedy, the Soviets remove the missiles.
Soviet troops invade Afghanistan. Aided by the U.S., Islamic fighters wage a `text(10-year)` guerrilla war against the Soviets, who withdraw in `1989`.
